name: Abu Sa'id Mirza
contribution: The ruler of the Timurid Empire during the mid-fifteenth century.
legacy: Over the course of two decades, he reunified much of the Timurid Empire, which had become fractured in the aftermath of the death of his great-uncle Shah Rukh.

checks.lead: Abu Sa'id Mirza (Chagatay/Persian: ابو سعید میرزا; 1424 – 5 February 1469) was the ruler of the Timurid Empire during the mid-fifteenth century.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
